277543294.description:
Kingdom
Professional Premium 92 Minute Blank Audio Cassette Tapes
Bulk Lot
This is a bulk lot of vintage blank audio cassette tapes from Kingdom Tapes & Electronics. These "Professional Premium" tapes provide a 92-minute recording capacity (46 minutes per side) and feature a clean white shell design. Produced in the United States, these cassettes were designed for high-fidelity voice and music reproduction, making them a preferred choice for professional and ministry distribution during the peak of the analog era.
High-quality white cassette shells with no pre-applied labels
92-minute total recording time (C-92) across two sides
Made in the USA at the Kingdom facility in Mansfield, PA
Measurements (Original Box): 17" x 11" x 3"
Original decorative storage box with vintage American flag graphic
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with tapes appearing unused. The cassette shells are clean and free of dust or physical damage. The outer cardboard shipping box shows moderate shelf wear, including some compression at the corners and light surface scuffing consistent with long-term storage.
